description.value: Sushi Man is a well-established Japanese restaurant on Marine Drive in North Vancouver, celebrated by long-time regulars for the freshness and simplicity of its sushi — no heavy sauces masking the fish. The menu spans classic nigiri and sashimi to inventive specialty rolls, with vegetarian, vegan, and teriyaki options rounding out the selection. A novelty sushi delivery robot adds a modern, playful touch to the otherwise casual, family-friendly dining room.
